**Problem**

What you are trying to do, and why the gem does not support it today.

**Proposed change**

What you would like to see. If you have an implementation in mind, describe it, including how it
fits the design constraints in CONTRIBUTING.md (host-agnostic engine, no change to tool names or
JSON-RPC error codes without a major version, and so on).

**Alternatives considered**

Any other way to solve the problem, and why you did not prefer it.
